concerns.text: SC-004 defines a χ² goodness‑of‑fit test between the observed cross‑correlation ξ(θ) and the theoretical ISW curve, requiring χ²/ndf ≤ 1.5 (p≥0.05). The specification does not provide per‑bin uncertainty estimates (σ_i) for ξ(θ), nor does it describe how the covariance between angular bins is handled. Without well‑defined variances or a covariance matrix, the χ² statistic is not statistically valid, making the validation of the ISW hypothesis circularly dependent on an ill‑specified error model.
